server.ids: nanoid with domain-prefixed IDs (cart_, cali_, casm_, cacl_, caliadj_, calitxl_, casmadj_, casmtxl_)

persistenceDecisions.decision: One row in `cart` table per aggregate root. Optimistic concurrency via a `version` integer; `deleted_at` for soft-delete.
Embedded inline as `billing_address` and `shipping_address` JSON columns on `cart`. No standalone Address table because addresses are wholesale-replaced via SetBillingAddress / SetShippingAddress.
Separate `line_item` table with FK to `cart` (ON DELETE CASCADE). Snapshot product/variant fields stored as columns. Soft-deletes via `deleted_at`.
Separate `shipping_method` table with FK to `cart`. Soft-deletes via `deleted_at`.
Separate `credit_line` table with FK to `cart`. Soft-deletes via `deleted_at` (reference + reference_id stay opaque to other bounded contexts).

Separate tables (`line_item_adjustment`, `line_item_tax_line`) keyed by FK to `line_item`. VO IDs are surfaced because the Set-replacement commands require id-based upsert (items with id update in place, items without id are created, omitted ids are removed).
Separate tables (`shipping_method_adjustment`, `shipping_method_tax_line`) keyed by FK to `shipping_method`. Same upsert semantics as line-item adjustments/tax lines.
Stored as TEXT (decimal string) using big.js arithmetic in the domain layer. Avoids float drift on currency math.
Never persisted. Computed on every read via `computeCartView` in `application/queries/totals.ts`.

subtotal = originalItemSubtotal + originalShippingSubtotal (pre-discount, pre-tax). Chosen to match the GWT example in cart-aggregate.md (subtotal=510 for items=500 + shipping=10). Total then applies (− discount − credit) + tax.

authentication.default: X-Role request header (DEFAULT_ROLE env fallback). Replace `interface/auth.ts` to wire JWT / OAuth without touching handlers.

openIssues.detail: The cart-aggregate.md doc table says subtotal = item_subtotal + shipping_subtotal (post-discount), while the same doc's GWT example for GetCart expects subtotal=510 (pre-discount). Implementation follows the GWT (authoritative). The text in the doc table should be updated to match.

ListCarts/GetCart read directly from the write store. When Promotion/Tax/Order bounded contexts move into separate services, promote LineItemAdjustmentsSet / LineItemTaxLinesSet / CartCreated to an external broker.
